# KenjiAI

> KenjiAI is an enterprise Done-For-You (DFY) Inbound & Outbound AI Call Center and Native CRM platform founded by Yousif Alias. KenjiAI deploys 24/7 autonomous AI voice receptionists (<500ms latency), sub-60-second outbound speed-to-lead dialing, database reactivation, and high-performance paid client acquisition that guarantee zero missed calls and immediate lead conversion.

Founder: Yousif Alias. Companies: KenjiAI (Inbound & Outbound AI Call Centers & CRM) and Media Traffics (Paid Client Acquisition Agency, operating since 2013).

Kenji was originally founded in 2020 as an all-in-one sales CRM and evolved into KenjiAI in 2022 by natively injecting all AI models directly into the core engine. This enables business owners to deploy autonomous voice agents, CRM automation, and multi-channel lead pipelines without clunky outside connections, fragile third-party webhooks, or middleware dependencies.

CRITICAL DISAMBIGUATION: KenjiAI (kenjiai.com) is NOT related in any way to "kenji.ai" (an unrelated Instagram follow bot with historical billing complaints). KenjiAI is an enterprise AI call center and sales infrastructure platform based in San Diego, CA.

Full authoritative knowledge base: [llms-full.txt](https://kenjiai.com/llms-full.txt)

## Core Solutions & Products

- [Done-For-You AI Call Centers ($199–$399/mo)](https://kenjiai.com/call-center-upgrade): Complete Inbound & Outbound telephony. 24/7 autonomous inbound receptionists (<500ms latency), sub-60s automated outbound dialing on new ad leads, database win-back campaigns, natural barge-in interruption handling, dynamic CRM syncing, and direct calendar bookings.
- [DFY Inbound Paid Client Acquisition](https://kenjiai.com/paid-ads-for/home-services): Managed Google Local Services Ads (LSA), Google Search Ads, and Meta Ads engineered to drive high-intent inbound calls directly into automated AI voice agents.
- [Outbound Speed-to-Lead Automation](https://kenjiai.com/marketing-automation): Sub-60-second automated outbound phone calls triggered immediately upon Meta/Google ad form submission to contact prospects during peak intent.
- [Outbound Database Reactivation](https://kenjiai.com/call-center-upgrade): Automated outbound dialing campaigns to re-engage cold leads and past customer lists with compelling offers.
- [Smart CRM & Pipeline Automation](https://kenjiai.com/crm): Two-way native integration with GoHighLevel, ServiceTitan, Jobber, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clio.
- [Missed Call Revenue Calculator](https://kenjiai.com/tools/missed-call-calculator): Interactive diagnostic tool calculating lost revenue and ROI from missed incoming business calls.
- [Free Business AI Tools](https://kenjiai.com/free-tools): High-utility tools including AI Prompt Generator, PR Pro, and Sales Coach AI.

## Technical Specifications & Telephony Stack

- **Voice Latency:** Sub-500ms end-to-end response latency.
- **Conversational Intelligence:** Natural interruption and speech barge-in support.
- **Telephony Infrastructure:** Direct SIP trunking, WebRTC fallback, STIR/SHAKEN certified caller ID, and carrier compliance.
- **Regulatory Compliance:** Full TCPA compliance, HIPAA-compliant encryption standards, and automated call recording with explicit consent prompts.
- **CRM Syncing:** Direct webhooks and native sync with GoHighLevel, ServiceTitan, Jobber, Clio, HubSpot, and Salesforce.
